subject: fixed issue in constrained vector/matrix dimensions

messages.subject: fixed issue in constrained vector/matrix dimensions
parts:
I patched the bug in type inference for constrained
vectors (simplex, ordered) and matrices (covariance
matrices, correlation matrices). The fix was
pushed to Google code in commit:

commit 5179786a67fd53a1f995bd2131eeb50e69b1fd9d
Author: Bob Carpenter <ca...@alias-i.com>
Date: Tue Sep 18 15:24:03 2012 -0400

fixed issue with hidden dims for corr_matrix, cov_matrix, simplex, and ordered

Until our next official release, putting any of these constrained
vector or matrix types in an array makes them invisible to the code.
There's not a good workaround because the constraints are necessary.

If you want to work with the above commit tag, it's good
to go from Git.

It was another "C++ isn't like Java" bug that bit me.
I redeclared member variables on the constrained subclasses
of matrix types, but called them through superclass refs,
so the correct ones were hidden. I'm sort of surprised
lint didn't catch that -- the Java compiler issues a warning
if you hide variables like this.

Thanks again for the report and sorry again for the bug.

- Bob
